subject: Philosopher in Residence Program
overview: Dominic Catino interviewed Audrey Ledbetter regarding her role as the Philosopher in Residence at Medford High School and the inclusion of philosophy in the secondary curriculum. Ledbetter discussed the program's impact on student critical thinking and the recent success of the school's Ethics Bowl team.

items.title: Role of the Philosopher in Residence
items.summary: Audrey Ledbetter defined her position as a way to integrate philosophy into high schools through guest lectures and workshops without requiring the district to hire dedicated philosophy faculty.

items.title: Ethics Bowl and Workshop Programs
items.summary: Ledbetter reported that the Medford High School Ethics Bowl team placed fourth at the national competition and described her work with the Tufts Philosophy Workshop after-school program.

items.title: Educational Value of Philosophy
items.summary: The importance of philosophy in high school was attributed to its ability to foster independent critical thinking, argument structuring, and democratic empowerment in students.

items.title: Ethical Topics and Curricular Reach
items.summary: Ledbetter detailed specific ethical topics covered in class, such as the morality of ChatGPT and GMOs, and expressed interest in collaborating with additional departments like mock trial.

items.title: Research Interests and Recommendations
items.summary: The interview concluded with Ledbetter discussing her research into the philosophy of character and her admiration for the work of contemporary philosopher Amiya Srinivasan.
